# Funnel Platform Picker Skill for Muse

Chooses a landing page or sales funnel platform from your actual case, not a feature grid: it demands six inputs (monthly GMV through the funnel, number of funnels/clients, contact list size, where catalog and orders must live, who maintains it, exit tolerance), then computes the real cost curve — flat fee vs percentage-of-revenue — with a worked crossover example, so you can see exactly where "cheaper" stops being true. It compares ClickFunnels, CartFlows, FunnelKit, systeme.io, GoHighLevel, Shopify apps, hand-rolled pages, and self-hosted open-source options; it checks "open source" claims itself (OSI-approved license? real repo? real releases? runs without a paid key?); and every recommendation must state the trade-off out loud. Discovered via skills.sh. Honest note: it includes a candid section on the creator's own Autonnel (Apache-2.0) — when to recommend it and, explicitly, when not to — a disclosed, unusually honest vendor pitch. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Not verified.
